plans.idea: Keep the original's editorial split: the logo pill sits small at top-left, a left text column runs headline to list, the bottle stands opposite it on the right, and the CTA pill closes the column on the same left edge.
Text leads at the top: a small logo above a full-width headline and copy block, then a bottom row pairs the bottle at left with the CTA pill at right, sharing one baseline band.
A centred poster on one vertical axis: the logo centred at top, the bottle as a centred emblem, the copy block below it, and the CTA pill centred at the foot.
